views.markdown:
YTCommentBox shows YouTube's "Comment..." box under every video, in place of the comments preview.

- **Always there**: YouTube picks a comments preview or a comment box per video; with YTCommentBox it's always the box.
- **Ready to write**: tap it and the comments open with the keyboard up.
- **Looks native**: your account picture, dark and light mode, and YouTube's press effect.

No settings. Also works injected into a sideloaded YouTube app.

views.title: Compatibility
views.text: iOS 14 and later (rootless, roothide and rootful); tested with YouTube 20.42.3

views.markdown: - The comments preview no longer flashes through the box when its comments change.
